candidates.change_summary: Removed the initialization guard so SetMinSum no longer reverts if intitalized is true; the function now always sets MinSum to _val.
Invert the condition so it only sets MinSum when intitalized is true (previously it set only when not initialized), changing when MinSum can be updated.
Remove the non-reentrancy lock assignment to allow reentrant calls through the modifier, potentially enabling reentrant updates to MinSum when SetMinSum is called.
Make the modifier leave the lock set to true after function execution, preventing subsequent SetMinSum calls and changing MinSum update behavior.
Replace the require-reverting check with allowing SetMinSum to always set MinSum even when intitalized is true (remove the revert guard), changing observable MinSum after call.
Change the guarded revert check to only revert when intitalized is false (inverted condition), allowing setting MinSum only after initialization which alters observable behavior compared to original.
Modify nonReentrant_ modifier to omit setting locked_ back to false after function execution, causing subsequent SetMinSum calls to revert on require and thus changing observed MinSum after calls.
Remove the lock setting so the nonReentrant_ modifier no longer prevents reentrancy by not setting locked_ = true (only checks and then resets).
Remove the revert guard on initialization so SetLogFile will assign Log even if intitalized is true (delete the if(intitalized)revert(); check).
Invert the initialization check so SetLogFile only assigns Log when intitalized is true (adds conditional assignment), changing when callers can set the Log file.
Replace the body of C.Initialized() so it sets intitalized = false instead of true, flipping the stored value after the call.
Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier so it does not reset the lock after the call, leaving locked_ true and potentially preventing future Initialized calls from executing.
Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier so it inverts the require check, allowing the modifier to proceed only when locked_ is true; this changes whether Initialized() can run and thus the final state.
